getro-elize.text: Signature proposal: a 110-acre mixed-use Palmdale City Walk & Convention Center with 2,000 residential units, entertainment and dining, convention space and a sports club.

source.title: Getro Elize campaign: Getro's Vision for Palmdale

getro-elize.text: As Vice Chair of the Palmdale Planning Commission, says "I have supported housing opportunities, economic development, infrastructure investment"; wants to "create more housing options" and offer affordable housing.
Public safety plank: "Strengthening partnerships between law enforcement and community organizations."
Endorsed by SEIU-United Healthcare Workers West (SEIU-UHW).

source.title: Getro Elize For City Council (campaign site)

eric-ohlsen.text: (2023) Per AV Press coverage, on Santa Monica's housing-transfer idea he was open to exploring it only if it meant workforce housing, not moving Santa Monica's unhoused population, noting Palmdale has land but lacks development funding.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Palmdale, Santa Monica talk housing (2023-02-17)

eric-ohlsen.text: (2023) Urged removing references to LA Mayor Karen Bass from a resolution against relocating unhoused people to Palmdale: "We need to find ways to work with her instead of against her."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: City sharpens resolution on homeless issue (2023-01)

eric-ohlsen.text: As mayor, backed putting a directly elected mayor measure on the ballot despite an estimated $436,000 cost and possible legal challenges: "Maybe that's the price you pay for democracy."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Palmdale eyes at-large vote to elect mayor (2026)

eric-ohlsen.text: (2022) Campaign platform: "There has been a tendency to overlook the presence of illegal drugs, graffiti, street racing, and other criminal activity"; pledged to draw on his law-enforcement experience.

source.title: Eric for Palmdale (2022 campaign site, Ohlsen for Council 2022)

eric-ohlsen.text: (2022) Campaign platform pledged to tackle illegal dumping in the desert through city partnerships to "remedy existing environmental harm and prevent future disasters."

source.title: Eric for Palmdale (2022 campaign site, Ohlsen for Council 2022)

eric-ohlsen.text: (2020) Running for Assembly, described himself as "a proud Progressive endorsed by Our Revolution, Blue America, and the California Progressive Alliance"; priorities: ending corporate and political corruption, middle-class jobs and housing.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Eric Andrew Ohlsen (2020 Candidate Connection survey)

eric-ohlsen.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party.

source.title: Los Angeles County Democratic Party: Endorsed Candidates (2026)

notes: No findable positions for mark-maldonado or francisco-sanchez (the sanchez4palmdale.com domain on the city candidate list is parked; no coverage found). Ohlsen has no 2026 campaign site; his 2022 site, 2020 Ballotpedia survey (identity confirmed via BallotReady) and AV Press council coverage were used.
